035/**
036 * Provides a high-level API (façade) for reading and writing all core PAINT data tables
037 * (Experiment Info, Recordings, Squares, and Tracks).
038 * <p>
039 * The {@code MainIOInterface} serves as the primary entry point for I/O operations. It
040 * coordinates between high-level model requests and low-level Tablesaw-based implementations
041 * found in the {@code internal} package. It handles path resolution, schema extraction from
042 * enums, and error logging.
043 * </p>
044 * <ul>
045 *   <li>Centralized access for all CSV table operations.</li>
046 *   <li>Automated schema management using entity Column enums.</li>
047 *   <li>Standardized error reporting via {@link PaintLogger}.</li>
048 *   <li>Support for both project-level and experiment-level I/O.</li>
049 * </ul>
050 */
051public final class MainIOInterface {
052
053    private MainIOInterface() { }
054
055    // =====================================================================
056    //  INTERNAL HELPERS — Extract schema arrays from Column enums
057    // =====================================================================
058
059    private static String[] extractHeadersExperimentInfo() {
060        ExperimentInfo.Column[] cols = ExperimentInfo.Column.values();
061        String[]                arr  = new String[cols.length];
062        for (int i = 0; i < cols.length; i++) {
063            arr[i] = cols[i].header;
064        }
065        return arr;
066    }
067
068    private static ColumnType[] extractTypesExperimentInfo() {
069        ExperimentInfo.Column[] cols = ExperimentInfo.Column.values();
070        ColumnType[]            arr  = new ColumnType[cols.length];
071        for (int i = 0; i < cols.length; i++) {
072            arr[i] = cols[i].type;
073        }
074        return arr;
075    }
076

131
132    // =====================================================================
133    //  EXPERIMENT INFO
134    // =====================================================================
135
136    public static List<ExperimentInfo> readExperimentInfo(Path experimentPath) {
137        ExperimentInfoTableIO experimentInfoTableIO = new ExperimentInfoTableIO();
138        try {
139            Table table = experimentInfoTableIO.readCsvWithSchema(
140                    experimentPath.resolve(EXPERIMENT_INFO_CSV),
141                    extractHeadersExperimentInfo(),
142                    extractTypesExperimentInfo(),
143                    false
144            );
145            return experimentInfoTableIO.toEntities(table);
146        } catch (Exception e) {
147            PaintLogger.errorf("Failed to read %s : %s",  EXPERIMENT_INFO_CSV, friendlyMessage(e));
148            return null;
149        }
150    }
151
152
153    public static void writeSpecificExperimentInfoFile(Path file, Table table) {
154        ExperimentInfoTableIO experimentInfoTableIO = new ExperimentInfoTableIO();
155        try {
156            experimentInfoTableIO.writeCsv(table, file);
157        } catch (Exception e) {
158            PaintLogger.errorf("Failed to write %s : %s", file, friendlyMessage(e));
159        }
160    }
161
162    public static void writeSpecificExperimentInfoFile(Path file, List<ExperimentInfo> list) {
163        ExperimentInfoTableIO experimentInfoTableIO = new ExperimentInfoTableIO();
164        writeSpecificExperimentInfoFile(file, experimentInfoTableIO.toTable(list));
165    }
